```python
import pixeltable as pxt

# Open the existing films table
films = pxt.open_table('films')

# Create a lazy query: filter by year > 1990 and project title and revenue columns
query = films.where(films.year > 1990)[['title', 'revenue']]

# Materialize the results locally
results = query.collect()

# Display the results
print(results)
```
